Returning to Allah, Islamic Spiritual Se.intro: Ten booklets by Dr. Yusuf Al-Qalb on returning to Allah, from remembrance, patience and du'a to gratitude, purifying the heart, trust and contentment, ending with a night-time companion for the Muslim soul. Numbered 1 to 10.

The Meridian Sequence.intro: A three-book science-fiction series by Eleanor Hart following astronomer Dr Lena Kasra and the crew of the survey ship Meridian as they trace an impossible signal and approach first contact. Best read in order.

Dr Claire Shaw series.intro: A psychological mystery series by Anna Wray, set in West Yorkshire and following Dr Claire Shaw, where clinical observation meets hidden truths. Three books so far.
